The other major New York‑based network that shares ABC’s city‑founded status is **CBS** (its headquarters are in New York City).  
**Celebrity Big Brother** made its debut on that network on **Wednesday, February 2, 2023**, airing 8 p.m.–9 p.m. ET/PT for the first episode of Season 3. The series then ran on CBS every weekday (and on weekends) through that season.

**Celebrity Big Brother** made its debut on that network on **Wednesday, February 2, 2023**, airing 8 p.m.–9 p.m. ET/PT for the first episode of Season 3. The series then ran on CBS every weekday (and on weekends) through that season.
